summary.decision_summary: Sigma Chi Whiteout won by 9.3. Sigma Chi Whiteout left 4.0 lineup points on the table, while Nacua-Cola left 25.9.
summary.historical_summary: Sigma Chi Whiteout is 20-17 against Nacua-Cola across 37 meetings between these managers.
summary.winner_reason: Sigma Chi Whiteout won by 9.3, led by a 16.6-point edge at QB. The leading starters were Drake Maye (31.3) and Jonathan Taylor (21.0).
summary.loser_reason: Nacua-Cola could not match the opponent's QB production, losing that position battle by 16.6 points. Texans scored 3.0. Its best legal lineup added 25.9, enough to put the lineup decisions directly in the result.
